Abhi
Key Takeaways
Out of five leads, four responded positively, with two involving mobile homes, which present challenges due to lack of associated land.
A property in El Paso was not acquired due to high seller expectations, but communication remains open for future possibilities.
Keyword research has been conducted to optimize the website for high-volume search terms related to foreclosure and distressed properties.
A new text message template will be implemented to make communication appear more personal and gather necessary property details.
The team plans to prioritize website development and video content creation, with a focus on improving ad performance and lead generation.
The team discussed the challenges and risks associated with mobile home leads, including owner financing and market expectations.
A new video script is finalized, but further work is needed on tone and layout before it goes live.
Keyword research has been conducted to optimize the website for high-volume search terms related to distressed properties and foreclosure.
A recent property deal was closed, and another is expected to close by December 30th, with ongoing negotiations for a million-dollar house.
Plans were made to update the automated text message for leads to make it more personal and request property details upfront.
Lead Responses and Engagement
Out of five leads, four responded positively; two involved mobile homes, posing challenges due to lack of associated land, making them similar to vehicles in terms of investment risk.
Mobile homes seen as risky investments due to low resale value, potential buyer defaults, especially when engaging in owner-finance deals.
High-value properties, like $1.5 million house, face conversion difficulties due to seller's high price expectations, which do not align with current market trends.
Follow up on high-value leads after 30 days in cases where sellers have high expectations, monitor changes in market dynamics, seller willingness.
Modify initial text message to ask for property details, enhancing lead engagement, making communication appear more personal, targeted.
Mobile Home Sales
Evaluating financial risks associated with owner financing, including potential default and resale challenges.
Considering owner financing mobile homes despite risks, with plans buy low, sell higher on installment basis.
Lack of land reduces value, making it challenging to profit from owner financing.
Selling mobile homes without land is challenging due to potential buyer defaults and difficulties in reselling.
Sales of mobile homes without land present challenges similar selling cars due lack of associated real estate. This affects resale value, securitization options, and marketability.
High-Value Property Deals
High-value deals like $1.5 million property in El Paso present challenges due to increased costs, risk factors, particularly given Abhi's unfamiliarity with the local market.
Follow up after 30 days on high-value leads to reassess market conditions, seller expectations, ensuring strategic approach to negotiations.
High holding costs, interest risks, especially in unfamiliar markets like El Paso, where Abhi lacks local expertise, making deals more daunting.
Prioritize large deals in familiar areas like Dallas, Austin, Houston, San Antonio to mitigate risks, leverage local market knowledge.
Property Deal Closures
Monitoring negotiations on high-value properties like $1.5 million house, with plans to follow up on seller's stated offers and assess validity.
Continuing efforts to close current pipeline deals by year-end, with focus on understanding market potential and risk management.
Closing property deals, including smaller condo and potential high-value house, part of current pipeline.
High holding costs, financial risks associated with large deals, such as those in unfamiliar markets like El Paso.
Lead Response and Quality
Managing expectations from high-priced leads, like $1.5 million house in El Paso, which are difficult due to market conditions and geographical constraints.
Following up on high-value leads assess changes in market demand, seller expectations.
High response rate from leads shows effectiveness of outreach efforts, with majority engaging in conversations.
Modify automated text messages to appear more personal, increase engagement. Include requests for property addresses, details.
Video Content Development
Video production pending; significant work remains on tone, visuals, and execution to align with finalized script and effectively convey message.
Update video content to align with script, ensuring it communicates urgency, brand’s unique selling propositions in property dealings.
Video script finalized, focusing on urgency and efficiency in handling property issues, such as foreclosures and distressed sales, to communicate Good Deeds' service approach.
Video and Marketing Strategy
Finalizing script for marketing video, focusing on themes of foreclosure, distressed properties, while ensuring tone aligns with brand message.
Implementing keyword research for SEO, using high-volume keywords to optimize for organic traffic.
Developing marketing video and content strategy attract motivated leads for real estate solutions.
Video needs refinement and completion to effectively communicate services and attract leads.
Website Development
Prioritize website launch by weekend, focusing on user-friendly template provided by team, incorporating SEO-optimized content.
Developing website enhance credibility, provide comprehensive information potential clients.
Use simple content initially, add more details as business grows, allowing flexibility in content strategy, ensuring site remains relevant, informative.
Website under development to improve credibility, enhance online presence, complement existing company communications.
Lack of website currently affects credibility, potentially limiting reach and effectiveness of digital marketing efforts.
Launching website within 2-3 days boost credibility, incorporating simple content initially, with plans expand as business grows.
Utilizing keyword research to drive organic traffic, focusing on terms related to foreclosure, distressed properties.
Keyword Research and SEO
Use high-volume keywords for website content, focusing on terms like "foreclosure" and "distressed property" to improve search engine rankings.
Keyword research conducted to optimize content for attracting organic traffic related to foreclosure, distressed properties, aiming to increase visibility, reach potential leads.
Develop content strategy targeting high-volume keywords, clustering them into categories related to business objectives, like divorce property, foreclosure.
Text Message and Communication Strategy
Modify initial text message for better engagement, making it appear more tailored, direct, increasing chances of lead response.
Text communication strategy revised to include request for property address, aiming to make interactions more personalized, efficient in gathering necessary information.
Use templates for consistency, analytics, allowing for streamlined communication, easier tracking of lead engagement metrics.
